concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-nonce-create-node]] - Node.js server-side payment-method nonce creation from a payment-method token, with Braintree's guidance that merchants should only create these nonces server-side for 3D Secure or Checkout with PayPal, plus the missing-payment-method error route
warnings: Preserve the advisory modal: Braintree says merchants should only create payment-method nonces server-side for 3D Secure or Checkout with PayPal; do not recast this as a categorical unsupported or prohibited boundary outside those cases.
Keep the operation scoped to the Node.js server SDK and do not present nonce creation as transaction creation, payment authorization, or payment success.
